description_zh: Waymo AV在并线过程中减速让行右侧来车，被后方的卡车追尾。将Waymo AV选为ego（因并线决策具有测试价值），卡车作为NPC从同车道后方撞上。碰撞类型为追尾。

source_snippets: While attempting a merge onto northbound Bayshore Boulevard from southbound Bayshore Boulevard, the Waymo AV came to a stop to yield for approaching traffic on the right. The Waymo AV was rear ended by the truck...
evidence.reason: 两车均在移动中，ego执行减速让行动作，NPC从后方追尾，属于典型同车道追尾场景，现有词汇表可表达。
